callees.name: _matches_inject_target
callees.pre_condition: url is a normalized URL string (trailing slashes stripped, falsy values converted to empty string). target is a string representing an inject-target host pattern.
callees.post_condition: Returns True when url matches the target pattern according to the configured host-matching rule; returns False otherwise.

callees.name: _inject_targets
callees.post_condition: Returns a list of strings, each representing a configured host pattern for which user-identity injection is enabled.
